description: This file contains helper functions for creating and handling multiple git packs. It defines functions to generate large numbers of packs and configure git to avoid automatic garbage collection during pack creation.

methods.name: create_packs
methods.description: Creates specified number of git packs, each containing a single blob with generated data, using Perl for data generation and git fast-import.

methods.name: setup_many_packs
methods.description: Sets git configuration to disable automatic garbage collection and pack limits, then calls create_packs to generate 500 packs.
